fields.System.Title: [TC-14Y-001 | Src:Code | Public] Wizard data sent over HTTPS only; submitter PII (RSA ID, email, phone) is not echoed into application logs
fields.System.Description: Preconditions: Network capture tool (browser DevTools) available. Access to application log files or test-env log aggregator.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.TCM.Steps: <steps id="0" last="4"><step id="1" type="ActionStep"><parameterizedString isformatted="true"><P>Open browser DevTools Network tab and submit a draft Application Wizard with synthetic PII</P></parameterizedString><parameterizedString isformatted="true"><P>All wizard requests use https:// scheme; no http:// requests</P></parameterizedString><description/></step><step id="2" type="ActionStep"><parameterizedString isformatted="true"><P>Inspect every request URL and response headers</P></parameterizedString><parameterizedString isformatted="true"><P>Strict-Transport-Security header is set; no mixed-content warnings in browser console</P></parameterizedString><description/></step><step id="3" type="ActionStep"><parameterizedString isformatted="true"><P>Capture the request correlation ID from response headers</P></parameterizedString><parameterizedString isformatted="true"><P>Correlation ID is present and unique per request</P></parameterizedString><description/></step><step id="4" type="ActionStep"><parameterizedString isformatted="true"><P>Search the application logs for the test submitter's RSA ID, email, and cellphone</P></parameterizedString><parameterizedString isformatted="true"><P>Logs reference the correlation ID but do not contain raw RSA ID, raw email, or raw cellphone - PII is redacted, masked, or omitted</P></parameterizedString><description/></step></steps>
